readerCopy.body: An old hurt can be admitted without requiring every independent choice made afterward to remain part of the same fight. When Chiron trines Lilith, sensitivity and autonomy reinforce each other, making it easier to separate an old rejection from the shame or pressure that became attached to it. A difficult memory can matter without controlling every present refusal. Independence becomes lighter when it no longer needs the old wound to stay active in order to justify itself.
